clue.text: Man scoring often has reluctant air running with ball

parts.note: loth (or loath) means unwilling or reluctant

indicators.note: running hints at something in motion, so the letters of air are shifted about

parts.note: a ball is round, the shape of the letter O

explanation.surface: A sportsman who scores a lot of goals has a hesitant manner when running with the ball.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man scoring often' means a man who often seduces, not a prolific striker. 'running' makes ARI from AIR.
explanation.definitionFit: A Lothario, after a seducer in Rowe's play, is a womaniser who scores with many partners.

clue.text: Reversing cut, forbidding strategy

indicators.note: the clue opens by telling us to turn the next word's synonym backwards

parts.note: to lop is to cut off branches
a forbidding look is cold and unfriendly, an icy one

explanation.surface: A government rejects a budget reduction as a policy, reversing a cut.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reversing' turns LOP into POL.
explanation.definitionFit: A policy is a planned course of action, the same thing as a strategy.

clue.text: Undergarment one dons to be credibly designed

indicators.note: to don is to put on clothing, so the rearranged letters are worn around the numeral
designed suggests the letters are fashioned into a new arrangement

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A fashion note: someone dons an undergarment so as to appear believably stylish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'designed' rearranges TO BE CREDIBLY, and 'dons' puts that anagram round I.
explanation.definitionFit: A liberty bodice was a warm, buttoned vest-like garment worn by British girls and women under their clothes.

clue.text: Angry queen cuddles new, undesirable bedfellow

indicators.note: to cuddle someone is to hold them in your arms, so these letters enclose another

parts.note: sore can mean annoyed or angry
R stands for regina, Latin for queen

explanation.surface: An irate queen hugs her new partner, who turns out to be unwelcome in bed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cuddles' puts N inside SORE + R.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who snores loudly through the night is a classic unwelcome person to share a bed with.

clue.text: Idyllic field's long hedges

indicators.note: to hedge a field is to enclose it, so these letters surround another

parts.note: to pant for something is to long for it
a lea is a field or meadow, and the possessive adds S

explanation.surface: A rural scene: a meadow with long, tall hedges looks perfectly idyllic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'long' looks like an adjective describing the hedges, but it is the verb meaning yearn; 'hedges' is the enclosing signal, not a noun.
explanation.definitionFit: Idyllic describes a peaceful, charming scene, which is agreeable and nice to be in.

clue.text: Destined for Great Lake as the last thing

parts.note: a train destined for a place is going to it
capital is an old exclamation meaning excellent or great
L is the abbreviation for lake on maps

explanation.surface: A traveller is bound for one of the Great Lakes as their final destination.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Great Lake' reads as Superior or Erie, but it splits into two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom is said of a final blow or crowning misfortune that comes on top of everything else.

clue.text: Transported quietly through desert

indicators.note: one letter passing through another word sits inside it

parts.note: to rat on someone is to desert or betray them
p (piano) is the musical marking for quietly

explanation.surface: Someone was carried quietly across a desert, as by caravan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'desert' looks like the noun of sand but is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To be transported in the emotional sense is to be carried away with delight, utterly absorbed.

clue.text: Make an impression in France and Switzerland

parts.note: et is French for and
CH is the international vehicle code for Switzerland

explanation.surface: Someone hopes to make a mark in both France and Switzerland.
explanation.definitionFit: To etch is to cut a design into a surface, literally leaving an impression in it.

clue.text: Change nurses developing entire type of medicine

indicators.note: to nurse something is to hold it closely, so these letters cradle others

parts.note: to vary is to change

indicators.note: developing suggests something changing shape, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A reform: nurses are developing an entire new kind of medical practice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nurses' looks like the medical staff of the surface, but it is the verb meaning hold; 'developing' rearranges the letters of entire.
explanation.definitionFit: Veterinary medicine is the branch that treats animals rather than people.

clue.text: Attendant in clubs and the bank for us

indicators.note: the words for us are placed in the middle of the others

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for clubs in card games
a tier is a bank or row, as of seats or oars
something for us is ours, so our

explanation.surface: An attendant works at clubs and the bank on our behalf.
explanation.definitionFit: A courtier is someone who attends a monarch at court.

clue.text: Perform, following musical style

indicators.note: the verb comes after the musical in the answer

parts.note: Hair is the 1960s rock musical
to do is to perform or carry out

explanation.surface: An instruction to perform after the music, in a certain style.
explanation.walkthrough: 'musical style' reads as one phrase, but the musical is Hair and style alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A hairdo is a style in which hair is cut and arranged.

clue.text: Vehicle went and shot round pass

indicators.note: the first two pieces go round the third, which is enclosed between them

parts.note: to have left is to have gone, so went
a drive is a powerful shot in golf or cricket
to hand something over is to pass it

explanation.surface: A driver went and shot round a mountain pass in their car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pass' reads as a mountain road but is the verb, and 'round' puts it between the other two.
explanation.definitionFit: A vehicle with its steering wheel on the left side is described this way, as in most of Europe and America.

clue.text: Primarily formal and stiff?

indicators.note: primarily means at first, so only the opening letter of formal is used

parts.note: rigid means stiff, unbending

explanation.surface: A description of someone who is above all formal and stiff in manner.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both the wordplay and the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone cold and stiffly formal in manner is often called frosty or chilly in this sense.

clue.text: Writer in romances, say, is touching

indicators.note: the answer sits inside these words, spanning several of them

explanation.surface: An author who writes touching romances, for example.
explanation.definitionFit: An essayist is an author of essays, a kind of writer.

clue.text: Men get old in US resort

parts.note: OR, other ranks, means ordinary soldiers or men
to land something is to get it

explanation.surface: Men who get old retire to an American holiday resort.
explanation.definitionFit: Orlando in Florida is a famous holiday destination, home of theme parks.

clue.text: German chemist, one making a career as a retailer

parts.note: Fritz Haber was the German chemist behind ammonia synthesis
to career is to rush headlong, so one doing so is a dasher

explanation.surface: A German chemist changes jobs to become a shopkeeper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'career' looks like a profession but is the verb meaning to rush.
explanation.definitionFit: A haberdasher is a shopkeeper who sells sewing goods or, in America, men's clothing.

clue.text: Harder to find clergyman admitting time's up

indicators.note: admitting means letting in, so these letters surround another piece

parts.note: RR, Right Reverend, is the title of a bishop

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the letters read from bottom to top

parts.note: an era is a period of time; the 's is just 'is'

explanation.surface: A churchman has become scarcer, admitting his time is over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns ERA into ARE, and 'admitting' puts it in RR.
explanation.definitionFit: Something rarer is scarcer, so harder to come across.

clue.text: Pay limo to travel around state capital

indicators.note: travelling around implies moving about, so the letters are shuffled

explanation.surface: Someone pays for a limousine to tour a state capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Olympia is the capital city of Washington State.

clue.text: Screw fitting around 45 inches, roughly

indicators.note: these letters go around the length unit, enclosing it

parts.note: proper means fitting or suitable
the old English ell was a measure of cloth of 45 inches

explanation.surface: A screw is being fitted around forty-five inches along, roughly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Screw' is a ship's propeller, not a fastener.
explanation.definitionFit: A ship's screw is its propeller, the rotating blades driving it through water.

clue.text: Foreign currency falsification with a twist in the tail?

indicators.text: with a twist in the tail
indicators.note: only the end of the word is twisted round, so its last two letters swap places

parts.note: a lie is a falsification of the truth

explanation.surface: A forgery of foreign money, with a surprise ending?
explanation.walkthrough: 'with a twist in the tail' turns IE into EI. Lei is the plural of leu, the Romanian currency.
explanation.definitionFit: The leu is the currency of Romania and Moldova; the plural is lei.

clue.text: Tend to enter contest and win everything

indicators.note: the first verb's synonym goes into the contest's synonym

parts.note: a cup is a contest, such as a knockout tournament
to tend to one side is to lean

explanation.surface: Someone is inclined to enter a competition and sweep the board.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tend' looks like caring for something but means incline.
explanation.definitionFit: To clean up is to take all the prizes or winnings, as at the card table.

clue.text: Calm about decline in fortune

indicators.note: the first piece goes about the second, enclosing it

parts.note: serenity is calm or tranquillity
a dip is a fall or decline

explanation.surface: Someone stays calm about a decline in their fortunes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'decline in fortune' reads as a phrase, but 'in' is a link and fortune alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Serendipity is the happy chance of finding good things by accident, a form of good luck.

clue.text: Was railing damaged in hedge I've cut?

indicators.note: something damaged is broken up, so these letters are reworked
cut means the last letter is chopped off the word before it

explanation.surface: Was a fence damaged in a hedge I have trimmed?
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut' makes IV from I'VE, and 'damaged' rearranges that with IN HEDGE. 'railing' looks like a fence but means ranting.
explanation.definitionFit: To inveigh is to protest angrily, and to rail is likewise to complain bitterly.

clue.text: Irritating poster showing Ford's model car

parts.note: the Model T was Henry Ford's famous car
Roller is slang for a Rolls-Royce car

explanation.surface: An annoying advert shows a Ford model car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'poster' is someone who posts online, not a billboard.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who posts provocative messages online to annoy people is a troll, here given an extended form.

clue.text: Theatrical Roman playing centre back for Internazionale

indicators.note: playing suggests letters moving around the field, so they are rearranged
the back of a word is its final letter

explanation.surface: A Roman footballer plays centre back for Inter Milan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'centre back' reads as a defender's position. 'playing' rearranges CENTRE into TERENC, and the last letter of Internazionale is E.
explanation.definitionFit: Terence was a Roman comic playwright, so a man of the theatre.

clue.text: Put right soldiers on deck

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece placed on another comes above it

parts.note: RE, Royal Engineers, are soldiers
to deck is to dress or adorn

explanation.surface: Soldiers are put right on deck, as on a ship's parade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'deck' reads as a ship's floor but is the verb to adorn.
explanation.definitionFit: To redress a wrong is to correct it or set it right.

clue.text: Realm of the departed, headless ghosts

indicators.note: headless means the first letter is removed

parts.note: shades are ghosts or spirits

explanation.surface: The land of the dead, full of headless phantoms.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Hades is the underworld where the souls of the dead go.

clue.text: Standard for learner to abandon chore

indicators.note: abandoning means leaving the word, so this letter is taken out

parts.note: a standard is a flag or banner
L is the learner-driver plate letter

explanation.surface: It is standard for a learner to give up a tedious task.
explanation.walkthrough: In British usage a fag is a tiresome job.
explanation.definitionFit: A fag is British slang for a tedious, wearisome task, a chore.
